claims.name: question-and-threshold-written-before-the-spike
claims.risk: no note holds the question and a numeric pass threshold, or no note of that kind was written before the first line of spike code

claims.name: spike-kept-in-the-working-area-as-throwaway
claims.risk: there is no spike code in the working area, or some of it is not marked as throwaway

claims.name: spike-was-run
claims.risk: the spike code was written but no command of the run named it

claims.name: missed-threshold-reported-as-fail
claims.risk: the answer does not report the spike as FAIL with a measured figure, does not say that the idea ends or changes, or recommends building

claims.name: spike-kept-out-of-the-product
claims.risk: code, a dependency manifest or a CI file was written outside the working area after a spike that missed its threshold
